name: Internet Health Pro
release_gate: one shared monitoring engine per plugin process
native ICMP latency with honest TCP-connect, DNS lookup and HTTPS response timing labels
multi-signal outage detection with two-cycle confirmation
ICMP-blocked network fallback without false 100% probe loss
user-adjustable latency, jitter and probe-loss thresholds
manual-only warmed adaptive throughput test capped at approximately 80 MB per run
clean Windows and macOS live network smoke
official Elgato Stream Deck CLI validation
deterministic Rat Art and marketplace kit preflight
final_boundary: Re-run Rat Dev on physical Stream Deck and verify the larger key typography, 30-second rolling graph visibility, live Property Inspector status, one warmed adaptive speed test, and disconnect/reconnect recovery before Marketplace submission.
qa_note: Hardware-QA fixes passed automation on candidate 8e5a3ac82d7a90970a52889a03f62e9825e5d738. Physical QA had found small on-key text, a ~10 MB cold-start speed sample that materially under-read fast links, and a Property Inspector that could remain on 'Starting monitor…'. Fixes now enlarge the key hierarchy, use a warmed adaptive Cloudflare speed test capped at about 80 MB, re-request inspector state while the panel is open, and improve Rat Dev bundle/profile visibility. Automated Windows/macOS tests, builds, live smoke, official Elgato validation/package, Rat Art, package/media verification, Rat Ship routing, Lite/Pro audit, and lightweight PowerShell checks all passed. Fresh physical Stream Deck retest is still required. Follow-up physical feedback found the visible latency graph was still tied to the long metric-history window, making recent movement collapse into a small strip. The key graph is now decoupled from analytics history and uses a fixed 30-second visual window with a taller plot area so recent spikes remain obvious.

profiles.reason: Internet Health Pro is a standalone utility and does not promise a bundled dashboard profile. PackRat bundles profiles when layout is part of the product promise, such as Voice Deck and Valorant Tracker.

upsell.note: Do not invent a Lite counterpart. net-spike remains explicitly classified as a standalone free XENEON network probe, not an Internet Health Lite edition.
